name: external-agents-path
description: Eval-only: puts the fixture external-agents stand-in first on the run's Bash PATH

hooks.command: g="$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)" || exit 0; d="$g/eval-external-agents/bin"; if [ -n "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] && [ -x "$d/external-agents" ]; then printf 'export PATH="%s:$PATH"\n' "$d" >>"$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; fi
